next_step_summary: PR #315 makes the existing blind synthetic evaluation runnable without adding a new retrieval selector. Run A now has one frozen stock-baseline prompt. Run B Pass 2/3 uses a deterministic ALL-CONTEXT semantic rule: the complete synthetic lease, complete current Mechanism Map and complete Concept Lexicon remain available, while Pass 1 Router is scored independently and cannot starve semantic analysis. Router scoring for v1 is unweighted: each missing expected family and unsupported extra family counts once; no critical/noncritical Router-label taxonomy is introduced. The synthetic lease text, expected Router families, 21 critical facts, 17 cross-clause checks, prohibited inferences, runtime, privacy boundary and real-contract corpus are unchanged. Next action: execute Run A on the selected base model in a fresh context and preserve the raw answer, then run B on the same model/version.
